Sexual and emotional violence during pregnancy
cohort: 700 women with low risk singleton pregnancy hospitalized for vaginal delivery with fetus in cephalic presentation and gestational age of 37(0)-41(6) at two teaching centers in Tabriz (Iran).
finding: Controllable factors during labor, such as anxiety, labor dystocia, insufficient support, interventions, and dehydration, were stronger predictors of low birth satisfaction than pre-labor factors.
mod_finding: Emergency cesarean section was a predictor of low birth satisfaction, while preference for cesarean section pre-labor was also a predictor.
